using System;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync_LogsErrorOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerForTest(loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await replicationManager.TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync(null, new ReplicateSyncOptions
            {
                NodeId = 1,
                TryAddReplica = true,
                Force = false,
                UpgradeLock = false,
                Background = false
            });

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result.Success);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains(nameof(ReplicationManager.TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync))),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // A derived class to override the clusterProvider to throw in TryAddReplicaAsync to trigger the catch block
        private class ReplicationManagerForTest : ReplicationManager
        {
            public ReplicationManagerForTest(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
                clusterProvider = new ClusterProviderForTest();
            }

            private class ClusterProviderForTest : IClusterProvider
            {
                public IClusterManager clusterManager { get; } = new ClusterManagerForTest();

                public IReplicationManager replicationManager => throw new NotImplementedException();

                public IServerOptions serverOptions => throw new NotImplementedException();

                public string ClusterUsername => throw new NotImplementedException();

                public string ClusterPassword => throw new NotImplementedException();
            }

            private class ClusterManagerForTest : IClusterManager
            {
                public ClusterConfig CurrentConfig => throw new NotImplementedException();

                public Task<(bool Success, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> Error)> TryAddReplicaAsync(long nodeId, bool force, bool upgradeLock, ILogger logger = null)
                {
                    // Simulate failure to trigger catch block
                    return Task.FromResult((false, Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("Simulated error")));
                }
            }
        }

        // Minimal stubs for types used in the method signature
        private class ReplicateSyncOptions
        {
            public long NodeId { get; set; }
            public bool TryAddReplica { get; set; }
            public bool Force { get; set; }
            public bool UpgradeLock { get; set; }
            public bool Background { get; set; }
        }

        private interface IClusterProvider
        {
            IClusterManager clusterManager { get; }
            IReplicationManager replicationManager { get; }
            IServerOptions serverOptions { get; }
            string ClusterUsername { get; }
            string ClusterPassword { get; }
        }

        private interface IClusterManager
        {
            ClusterConfig CurrentConfig { get; }
            Task<(bool Success, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> Error)> TryAddReplicaAsync(long nodeId, bool force, bool upgradeLock, ILogger logger = null);
        }

        private interface IReplicationManager { }

        private interface IServerOptions { }

        private class ClusterConfig { }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.Extensions
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogError_WithExceptionAndMessage_InvokesLoggerLogError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var exception = new Exception("Test exception");
            string message = "Test message";

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogError(exception, message);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains(message)),
                    exception,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
